MANILA, Philippines — Face-to-face classes are suspended in several areas on Monday, October 5, for the celebration of National Teachers’ Day.

In-person classes are suspended in the following:

Luzon

  • Province of Abra: all levels, public and private schools
  • San Carlos City, Pangasinan: all levels, public and private schools
  • Burgos, La Union: all levels
  • Angeles City, Pampanga: all levels, public and private schools
  • Sta. Rita, Pampanga: all levels, public and private schools
  • Victoria, Tarlac: all levels, public and private schools
  • Province of Laguna: for public schools

Visayas

  • Negros Oriental: all levels, public and private schools
